pet-static.description: NEMA phantom filled with Cu-61 (Phantom_NEMA_Cu61_kontrast8), static frame of 30 min, 33x33x37 voxels of 1.65 x 1.65 x 1.646 mm

source.notes: The reconstructed DICOM images were loaded into ROVER, cropped there and exported as ECAT7, Philips and raw data. The ECAT7 file was converted to NIfTI with a separate Python ecat2nifti tool, the NIfTI header/image pair was created from the DICOM images with PMOD. The ECAT7 main header contains the system type 962 written by ROVER. dicom/pet-static is a static reconstruction of the same acquisition covering the full field of view; it provides the patient coordinates of the cropped files (see the landmarks), its values differ slightly.

dicom/pet-static.notes: DICOM PET image series, 440x440x159 voxels of 1.65 x 1.65 x 1.6456 mm, one frame of 30 min, Bq/ml, image orientation [1,0,0,0,1,0], patient position HFS; slices sorted by increasing z. The cropped files of the dataset cover the columns 169-201, rows 206-238 and slices 81-117 with reversed slice order (same spatial structure, correlation 0.99999), but their values differ (ecat/pet-static.v = 0.9978 x DICOM - 509 Bq/ml, residual rms 61 Bq/ml): presumably a different reconstruction of the same acquisition.

ecat/pet-static.v.source: cropped DICOM images reconstructed with e7tools (not part of the test data)
ecat/pet-static.v.notes: ECAT7 Volume16, SunShort, scale factor 1.664825, calibration factor 1

nifti/pet-static.nii.gz.tool: ecat2nifti (separate Python tool converting between ECAT and NIfTI, not part of libmedio)
nifti/pet-static.nii.gz.notes: same stored int16 values and scale factor as ecat/pet-static.v with reversed z axis; qform_code and sform_code are 0; header (incl. a DICOM header extension) and voxel data are byte-identical to nifti/pet-static.pair except vox_offset and magic

nifti/pet-static.pair.source: DICOM images reconstructed with e7tools (not part of the test data)
nifti/pet-static.pair.notes: NIfTI-1 header/image pair (ni1) with the same content as nifti/pet-static.nii.gz

philips/pet-static.img.source: cropped DICOM images reconstructed with e7tools (not part of the test data)
philips/pet-static.img.notes: Philips image file; same stored int16 values and voxel order as ecat/pet-static.v

philips/pet-static.syn.source: cropped DICOM images reconstructed with e7tools (not part of the test data)
philips/pet-static.syn.notes: Philips Syntegra file; same stored int16 values and voxel order as ecat/pet-static.v

raw/pet-static.raw.source: cropped DICOM images reconstructed with e7tools (not part of the test data)
raw/pet-static.raw.notes: scaled values (Bq/ml) of ecat/pet-static.v in the same voxel order

pet-dynamic.description: NEMA phantom filled with Cu-61 (Phantom_NEMA_Cu61_kontrast8), dynamic with 3 frames (30 s, 60 s, 90 s), 31x31x39 voxels of 22.6875 x 22.6875 x 1.6456 mm

source.reconstruction: e7tools (dynamic reconstruction of the acquisition of pet-static)
source.units: Bq/ml (ECAT7 data units "Bq/cc" with calibration factor 1000)
source.notes: The dynamic DICOM images (dicom/pet-dynamic) were loaded into PMOD and saved as ECAT7, which was loaded into ROVER, cropped there to 31x31x39 voxels and exported as ECAT7, Philips and raw data. The cropped ECAT7 file was loaded into PMOD again and exported as NIfTI. The coarse in-plane voxel size results from the 32x32 matrix of the dynamic reconstruction over the 726 mm field of view (pet-static: 1.65 mm). The crop covers the DICOM columns and rows 0-30 and the slices 77-115 (sorted by increasing z), see the landmarks for the voxel correspondence.

dicom/pet-dynamic.notes: DICOM PET image series, 32x32x159 voxels, 3 frames, Bq/ml, image orientation [1,0,0,0,1,0], patient position HFS; slices sorted by increasing z

ecat/pet-dynamic.v.source: dicom/pet-dynamic (saved as ECAT7 by PMOD 4.006, cropped in ROVER)
ecat/pet-dynamic.v.notes: ECAT7 Volume16, SunShort, calibration factor 1000, a different scale factor per frame

nifti/pet-dynamic.nii.gz.notes: 4D int16 with a single scale factor (requantized frames 2 and 3) and reversed z axis compared to ecat/pet-dynamic.v; the ECAT7 calibration factor is not applied; qform_code and sform_code are 0, no frame timing (pixdim[4] = 0)

nifti/pet-dynamic.pair.notes: NIfTI-1 header/image pair (ni1) with the same content as nifti/pet-dynamic.nii.gz

philips/pet-dynamic.img.source: dicom/pet-dynamic (saved as ECAT7 by PMOD 4.006, cropped in ROVER)
philips/pet-dynamic.img.notes: Philips image file with 3 frames; same stored int16 values and voxel order as ecat/pet-dynamic.v

philips/pet-dynamic.syn.source: dicom/pet-dynamic (saved as ECAT7 by PMOD 4.006, cropped in ROVER)
philips/pet-dynamic.syn.notes: Philips Syntegra file with 3 frames; same stored int16 values and voxel order as ecat/pet-dynamic.v

raw/pet-dynamic.raw.source: dicom/pet-dynamic (saved as ECAT7 by PMOD 4.006, cropped in ROVER)
raw/pet-dynamic.raw.notes: only frame 3 of ecat/pet-dynamic.v: stored values x calibration factor (1000) x scale factor, same voxel order
